facts.rationale: OSM places the village at 19.2011N 98.8879E; a Commons photo titled 'Mae ta mann' geotagged ~200 m away (19.1995N 98.8894E) shows the Mae Taeng River.

The Taeng River separates the Thanon Thong Chai Range from the Daen Lao Range; the village lies on the river, and no reliable source assigns it to the Thanon Thong Chai foothills rather than the Daen Lao side.
